record.paper_title: Open Problems for Entire Functions of Bounded Index in Direction
record.context_brief: Combining bounded indices across variable blocks
record.original_question: Let F:C^{n+m}->C be entire, let L1:C^n->R+ and L2:C^m->R+ be positive functions, and split variables into a first block of n coordinates and a second block of m coordinates. Suppose that, for every fixed second block, F has uniformly bounded L1-index in the direction (b1,...,bn,0,...,0), and for every fixed first block, F has uniformly bounded L2-index in the direction (0,...,0,b_{n+1},...,b_{n+m}). What positive function L:C^{n+m}->R+ makes F have bounded L-index in the combined direction b = (b1,...,b_{n+m})?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n,m\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $F:\mathbb{C}^{n+m}\to\mathbb{C}$ be an entire function. Write the variable as $(z',z'')$ with $z'\in\mathbb{C}^n$ and $z''\in\mathbb{C}^m$. Fix a direction $\mathbf{b}=(b_1,\dots,b_{n+m})\in\mathbb{C}^{n+m}\setminus\{0\}$, and set $\mathbf{b}'=(b_1,\dots,b_n,0,\dots,0)$ and $\mathbf{b}''=(0,\dots,0,b_{n+1},\dots,b_{n+m})$ in $\mathbb{C}^{n+m}$.

Recall that for a positive continuous function $L:\mathbb{C}^{n+m}\to\mathbb{R}_+$ and a direction $\mathbf{b}\in\mathbb{C}^{n+m}\setminus\{0\}$, an entire function $G:\mathbb{C}^{n+m}\to\mathbb{C}$ is said to have bounded $L$-index in the direction $\mathbf{b}$ if there exists $N\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$ such that for every $z\in\mathbb{C}^{n+m}$,
$$\frac{1}{N!}\frac{|\partial_{\mathbf{b}}^N G(z)|}{L(z)^N}\ \ge\ \frac{1}{k!}\frac{|\partial_{\mathbf{b}}^k G(z)|}{L(z)^k}\qquad\text{for all }k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0},$$
where $\partial_{\mathbf{b}}G(z)=\sum_{j=1}^{n+m}b_j\,\partial G/\partial z_j(z)$ and $\partial_{\mathbf{b}}^k$ denotes its $k$-th iterate. The least such $N$ is the $L$-index of $G$ in the direction $\mathbf{b}$.

Now let $L_1:\mathbb{C}^n\to\mathbb{R}_+$ and $L_2:\mathbb{C}^m\to\mathbb{R}_+$ be positive continuous functions. Suppose:
(i) there exists $N_1\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$ such that for every fixed $z''\in\mathbb{C}^m$, the entire function $z'\mapsto F(z',z'')$ on $\mathbb{C}^n$ has $L_1$-index in the direction $(b_1,\dots,b_n)$ at most $N_1$;
(ii) there exists $N_2\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$ such that for every fixed $z'\in\mathbb{C}^n$, the entire function $z''\mapsto F(z',z'')$ on $\mathbb{C}^m$ has $L_2$-index in the direction $(b_{n+1},\dots,b_{n+m})$ at most $N_2$.

Determine an explicit positive continuous function $L:\mathbb{C}^{n+m}\to\mathbb{R}_+$, built from $L_1$ and $L_2$, such that $F$ has bounded $L$-index in the combined direction $\mathbf{b}$.

artifact.status_search_result: A web search returns substantial literature on entire functions of bounded L-index in direction and on relations between bounded L-index in joint variables and in direction, but no source was found that explicitly resolves the question of constructing a combined positive function L on C^{n+m} from L_1 on C^n and L_2 on C^m so that uniform bounded indices in the two coordinate-block directions imply bounded L-index in the combined direction. The current status of this specific question could not be verified.

status_evidence.title: Slice Holomorphic Functions in Several Variables with Bounded L-Index in Direction
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys properties of entire/slice holomorphic functions of bounded L-index in a given direction in C^n.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the topic area is active but does not directly resolve the block-combination problem.

status_evidence.title: Analytic functions in the unit ball of bounded L-index in joint variables and of bounded L-index in direction: a connection between these classes
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes connections between bounded L-index in joint variables and in direction.
status_evidence.claim: Related results exist on linking joint-variable and directional boundedness, but the specific block-combination construction was not located.
